I’m not done with corporate cronies from California and their subsidies. 

In fact quite the opposite.


Brad Johnson (@bradj_TX)

Inbox: Invest in Tomorrow Coalition PAC, the CA-based group spending $1 mil+ in #TXAG against @chiproytx, dances on the grave of Roy’s runoff loss.





— https://nitter.net/bradj_TX/status/2059446198033854952#m
Just a little while ago, I called and congratulated @mayes_middleton for his victory in our race for the Republican nominee for Attorney General.  I will have a full statement tomorrow.  Onward.
